findings.title: External identifier verification is stale
findings.evidence: ORCID:SYNTH-ORCID-ELENA-0001 was last verified 501 days before review.
findings.action: Refresh the ORCID, institutional, or external-profile verification before publishing profile trust signals.

findings.title: Identifier is already bound to another profile
findings.evidence: ORCID:SYNTH-ORCID-ELENA-0001 is already claimed by researcher-elena-voss.
findings.action: Block trust updates and open an identity-resolution case before endorsements or badges are applied.

findings.title: External identifier is not verified
findings.evidence: INSTITUTIONAL_EMAIL:evoss@northstar-labs.example is marked pending for profile profile-provisional-884.
findings.action: Hold reputation-bearing actions until the identifier is verified through an approved channel.

findings.title: Institutional affiliation does not match verified email domain
findings.evidence: Elena Voss claims Northstar Institute, but email domain northstar-labs.example is outside northstar.edu, research.northstar.edu.
findings.action: Require fresh affiliation proof or show the affiliation as unverified before profile exports or reputation changes.

findings.title: Affiliation verification is stale
findings.evidence: Affiliation was last verified 493 days before review.
findings.action: Refresh affiliation evidence before using the institution in leaderboards or citation pages.

findings.title: Profile uses a reserved or high-trust researcher display name
findings.evidence: Elena Voss matches a reserved researcher name without an approval record.
findings.action: Hold public trust badges and route the profile through manual identity review.

findings.title: Profile handle is visually close to a trusted researcher profile
findings.evidence: elena-v0ss-lab is distance 1 from trusted handle elena-voss-lab.
findings.action: Hold endorsements and require reviewer confirmation that the profile is not impersonating the trusted account.

findings.title: Display name is ambiguous with an existing researcher profile
findings.evidence: Elena Voss has 98% similarity with researcher-elena-voss.
findings.action: Render an ambiguity warning and require stronger verified identifiers before reputation deltas are shown.

findings.title: Profile identity fields changed shortly before a reputation-bearing event
findings.evidence: handle changed from ev-lab-provisional to elena-v0ss-lab 4 days before review.
findings.action: Freeze the affected reputation event until the changed identity field is acknowledged in the audit trail.

findings.title: Profile identity fields changed shortly before a reputation-bearing event
findings.evidence: displayName changed from E. Voss Research to Elena Voss 3 days before review.
findings.action: Freeze the affected reputation event until the changed identity field is acknowledged in the audit trail.

findings.title: Trust event would reveal an anonymous or double-blind reviewer identity
findings.evidence: review-credit-19 links profile identity into a double-blind review context.
findings.action: Block the public profile update and issue an anonymous-review-safe receipt instead.

findings.title: External profile evidence is weak
findings.evidence: GitHub confidence is 0.52 with proof profile-url-only.
findings.action: Show the external profile as unverified and exclude it from reputation calculations.
